name: harbourline
description: Harbourline — a deliberately imperfect multi-brand e-commerce platform used as the fixture for the Applied Devin Lab course.

scripts.lint: prettier --check . && eslint . && node scripts/ws.mjs run lint --all
scripts.labs:build: node scripts/ws.mjs run build -w labs --fallback labs/build.mjs
scripts.coach:dryrun: node scripts/ws.mjs run coach:dryrun -w labs --fallback labs/coach-dryrun.mjs --
scripts.gates: npm test && npm run lint && npm run build && npm run labs:build
